scope: Separate source-labelled CPU refutation of live/fresh-instance save reentry, declared item gate/localization and real imminent-attack cancellation. Real Game input mapping/Director/QuestSystem/Storage/AI/Combat. Appearance, input acquisition, UI, camera/post/audio devices are fixture stubs; no perception, damage or movement result is forced. refutationOutcome: No surviving finding in this bounded R3 review. R2-REENTRY closure and requested item/attack controls survive independent reproduction; unchanged controls are carried only with matched source hashes and retained raw evidence.

resolvedFindings.refutationAttempt: Tried to reproduce duplication both before saving and after restoring the valid accepted-before-poll state into a fresh Game instance. Neither path duplicates in R3. Replacing only Director with the R2 snapshot restores 3/6/9 duplication, so the positive result is not an inert fixture or an incidental world change.
resolvedFindings.mechanism: spawnTrenchLine now checks trench_talked before _spawnRaid, performs any pending stand-down and returns. Current live neutral actors preserve their IDs; reset-world restoration does not spawn replacements for the accepted line. The next ordinary poll still completes the passage flags and quest step.

priorDirectorCounterfactual.heldFixed: All R3 modules other than Director, including AI/City/Props/Game/Player/Storage/QuestSystem.

resolvedFindings.scope: This closes the explicit repeated-entry defect, which was always minor and did not claim that an ordinary single load produced nine actors.

controlsRefutation.correctness: No reach-timer or passage-flag assignment. One actual Game tick establishes the poll phase; actual target selection/input on the next tick accepts the order at 0.033333 s, with step 1 and 0.233333 s remaining before the next poll. Valid Storage save/load plus fresh-instance applySave and repeated entry are exercised.
controlsRefutation.reproducibility: Current live counts 3/3/3 preserve the same actor IDs; fresh loaded entry 0/0/0 and repeated applySave 0/0/0. Ordinary subsequent poll reaches step 2, with trench_passed and trench_talked_through and item count 1.
controlsRefutation.materiality: The original duplication mechanism is removed while both retained-actor and fresh-restoration progression remain functional.

controlsRefutation.correctness: Without an item, normal selected input remains in PLAY/step1, does not set passage flags, does not neutralize enemies, does not open a dialogue line, and emits the declared locked SFX plus appropriate notice. Giving one item then permits the same normal interaction; it remains present at count 1 after the next passage poll.
controlsRefutation.mechanism: The requiresItem branch runs before the interaction-kind switch. It reads state.hasItem, formats the item through the real locale table, emits the rejection and returns without _examine or _standDownTrench. It does not consume an available item.
controlsRefutation.scope: Declared-item consistency and notice-call localization only. It is not a claim that a full authored chapter journey can reach this situation without the order, nor a rendered/UI-readability evaluation.

controlsRefutation.correctness: Waited for real AI to commit an attack with a live CombatSystem token just before its active frame, then submitted the normal selected interaction. Missing-item rejection preserves combat/token/camera lock and produces real Warden damage. With the item, attack, token, target and camera lock clear, the line is neutral and the following eight CPU seconds contain zero Warden hits.
controlsRefutation.reproducibility: Independent no-item case records two hits/23 attack damage, while the parent run recorded two/22. Both establish a live damaging negative control. Actor-ID RNG makes these separate games rather than identical-state rewinds; the exact damage amount is not a universal guarantee.
controlsRefutation.scope: Only source-attributed Warden damage is counted. Continued gas simulation is not relabelled as a failed truce.

controlsRefutation.correctness: Inspected the retained R3 code and uninterrupted trace. The same four-tier geometry and actual Player movement complete the successful oblique segment while the current Director runs the actual quest. No later Y/position assignment or forced perception appears.
controlsRefutation.limits: This is one supported approach segment, not a full earlier-chapter journey or proof of visual discoverability/touch ease. The R3 final snapshot has alerted hostile Wardens and combat music; trench_slipped is a positional quest flag, not proof that nobody detected Ren. No new unseen-passage claim is accepted.

controlsRefutation.detail: AI, City, Props, Player, Game, Combat, narrative and Storage hashes match R2. The existing neutral reinforcement exclusion, hostile/player-faction controls, legacy rubble geometry/RNG identity and runtime cleanup controls retain their prior scope. R3 Director changes precede spawning and add the item gate; _standDownTrench behavior and these world/AI implementations are unchanged. No optional runtime rerun was used to enlarge claimed coverage.

The 90-second PLAY autosave remains explicitly a topic-only control with finale quest omitted. The separate actual finale flow supports CINEMATIC/completed save and no Warden damage in its measured intervals. It is not relabelled normal post-ending PLAY. R3 acceptance and next-poll step2 remain independently exercised, but the entire finale was not unnecessarily rerun here.

retainedObservations.detail: Failed direct-to-center paths and their blocked vault landings remain in prior evidence. Successful oblique routes do not erase those failures; direct failures also do not establish generic heap untraversability.
The declared gate is now enforced. Full authored progression without the order was never established and is not retroactively asserted as a prior gameplay exploit.

probeQuality.counterfactualFailurePreserved: R2 Director still fails the current constant-count target in raw evidence. This expected negative control is retained, not labelled a new probe error.

retention: All prior artifacts and failed attempts remain unchanged. The initial shortened R2 snapshot path was absent; the supplied full trench-perception-r2-reviewed-director.js path was discovered and hash-verified before its counterfactual use. No runtime result was discarded or overwritten.
recommendations: Close R2-REENTRY at the reviewed R3 pins; no new surviving finding emerged in this narrow refutation.
Keep item/attack/entry and retained world controls within their measured CPU scopes.
